enabled.description: Enable or disable the Lumina_PC execution layer.

shellApprovalRequired.description: Require explicit approval before executing shell commands.

heartbeatEnabled.description: Enable or disable the background system heartbeat service.

heartbeatIntervalMs.description: Interval in milliseconds for reporting system metrics to I24D.

screenshotDir.description: Directory where screenshots are saved. Defaults to %TEMP%\lumina-pc-screenshots.

watchedPaths.description: Paths to watch for file changes and report to I24D.
